kicker_pass2.why: owner 2026-10-24: first batch 'all average'; ETON best 'because it is technically already giving a good setup'. Pass 2 ranks detector hits by the setup BEFORE the kicker (scripts/study/find_kicker_examples.py).

oops_pass2.why: owner 2026-10-24 delegated the Oops pass ('You do that yourself and run it'); same lesson as the Kicker pass: rank detector hits by the setup behind the day (scripts/study/find_oops_examples.py): an uptrend, a pullback into the 21/50-day or a prior swing low, the Oops day reclaiming the short averages. 7 of the 10 pass-1 examples were downtrend bounces.

pass3.why: owner rules of 2026-10-24 (one-at-a-time review): liquid and sizable universe ($20M+/day dollar volume, close >= $10); must work on the forward strip; kicker = weak prior close, 1.5-6% gap, no earnings days; oops = orderly drift location, orderly prior day, technical-looking Oops day. scripts/study/find_pass3_examples.py

pass4.why: Kicker pass 4: the owner's trapped-sellers rule (prior red body >= 1%, range >= 0.9 ATR, close at/under the 5-day low, DCR <= 0.35), non-earnings only; Launchpad pass 2 on the owner's definition without the uct_launch_pad gate (the detector misses MSTR 2023-10-23). scripts/study/find_pass4_examples.py and find_launchpad_examples.py

launchpad_pass3.why: owner picture from the 2026-10-24 review: price under/on the bundle, the dangle above with retests, 9>20>50 on the trigger, breakout not required. scripts/study/find_launchpad_examples.py (pass 3 variant)

launchpad_pass4.why: owner 2026-10-24 after cutting TAN/MARA/TTC/ADM: 'revisit the MSTR example and try to find ones like that'. MSTR/TEAM/BIDU share: a long flat base where price lives UNDER and through the chunked 8/21/50 (below_bundle_40 high, above_bundle_40 low, price under the bundle 20 sessions before), the 50 flat, the 200 at/just under the chunk, then the first pop above everything. The cuts were V-rallies up into the bundle (above_bundle_40 ~20, below ~3). scripts/study/find_launchpad_examples.py (pass 4 variant)

slingshot_pass2.why: owner definition 2026-10-24 (a good rally or an earnings gapper, THEN a consolidation, THEN the first close back above the 4-day average of the highs; the drive day is never the trigger) scored on top of uct_slingshot.evaluate, with the universal rules (liquid universe, clean window, must-work). scripts/study/find_slingshot_examples.py

hve_pass2.why: owner ruling 2026-10-23 (long only; the HVE close is the level the biggest participants committed at and price must defend it; a strong close not required) on top of uct_hve.evaluate, with the universal rules and a must-DEFEND forward strip (no close below the HVE low, closes within 3% of the HVE close, +8% at the 20-day high). Ten non-earnings and six earnings-day HVEs so the owner can rule on earnings. scripts/study/find_hve_examples.py

hve_pass3.why: owner definition confirmed 2026-10-25: a volume day that dwarfs everything before it (>= 10x the 50-day average or >= 2.5x the prior-year record, and the record of the available lookback), often a lesser-known name, the start of a new story; earnings days can count; the HVE close is a LEVEL so there is no must-work gate; OPEX and month-end sessions excluded; fresh IPOs admitted (>= 60 prior sessions). scripts/study/find_hve_examples.py (pass 3 variant)

gap_support_pass2.why: the detector definition (uct_gap_support.evaluate) on varied real charts under the universal rules (liquid universe, clean window, must-work, the gap unfilled through the forward strip) and a gallery score (true gap, 2x+ volume, the gap top tested, first test, strong close, confluence, 10-40 sessions after the gap); owner ruling on the definition PENDING, this pass is for him to rule on it one chart at a time

go_signal_pass2.why: the detector's DAILY footprint (uct_go_signal.evaluate) on varied real charts under the universal rules and a gallery score (red to green, a long lower wick, a close in the top fifth, a named level swept, a recent run or tight base, ordinary range); owner ruling on the definition PENDING; the lesson says the real trigger is intraday
